about_short_description.short_description: Dr. Treat is a veterinary practice that offers personalized pet care services.

product.name: Dr. Treat One™ Membership
product.description: A subscription plan offering unlimited veterinary visits with no exam fees, same or next day urgent care appointments, and access to all clinics.

product.name: Primary Care Services
product.description: Routine veterinary services including physical exams, vaccinations, chronic disease management, and behavioral assessments to maintain pet health.

product.name: Surgical and Dental Services
product.description: Veterinary surgical procedures including spay/neuter, soft tissue and emergency surgeries, dental cleanings, extractions, and orthopedic evaluations.

product.name: Diagnostic Services
product.description: In-house diagnostic testing including blood work, urine tests, fecal screening, radiography, ultrasound, cardiology, and allergy testing.

identifier.value: Preventive Care for Puppies, Kittens, and Seniors

product.name: Preventive Care for Puppies, Kittens, and Seniors
product.description: Age-specific veterinary care programs focusing on vaccinations, health screenings, nutrition, and tailored wellness plans.

product.name: Urgent Care Services
product.description: Same or next day veterinary appointments for pets requiring prompt medical attention for non-emergency conditions.
